verdict.rationale: Bland is a voice AI phone platform, so real-time transcription and STT configuration is a fair question for this product. The evidence pack has nothing on transcription accuracy, choosing an STT provider, selecting language models, or key-term boosting. Its voice docs cover only TTS voice selection and cloning, which is a different capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get accurate real-time transcription with control over the STT provider, language models, or key terms
